Dim(name: str, size: Optional[int] = None)

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

A named symbolic dimension with an optional known size.

Two `Dim`\s are equal iff name and size match. A `Dim` is a valid
`DimExpr` operand and participates in arithmetic via the shared mixin.

## Attributes

- `name` · `str` — Dimension name (string). Dims with the same name unify.

- `size` · `Optional[int]` — Optional known size; `None` means unknown until runtime.
